req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-002 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is missing from POST /tasks/. The schema enforces title as required (min_length=1, max_length=100). Tests cover: (1) positive path — valid title yields 201, (2) negative path — missing title yields 422, (3) boundary — empty string title (length=0, below min_length=1) yields 422, (4) boundary — title of exactly 1 char (min boundary) yields 201, (5) negative — null title yields 422, (6) decision table — body with only description and no title yields 422. Mutation resilience: exact status codes asserted, both sides of the boundary tested (length 0 vs 1), boolean fields checked, response body fields verified.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201
preconditions: Database is initialized with pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with a valid title field
expected: Response body contains id, title, completed=false
trace: R-TASK-002: valid title must succeed with 201, not 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Valid Task Title", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Valid Task Title"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201()

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422
preconditions: Database is initialized with pre-loaded rows
actions: POST /tasks/ with body that omits the title field entirely
expected: Response body contains detail about missing title
trace: R-TASK-002: missing title must yield HTTP 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"description": "No title here", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    fields = [err.get("loc", []) for err in body["detail"]]
    title_missing = any("title" in loc for loc in fields)
    assert title_missing == True

test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422()
